## Guides
- [How to Buy a Flat in Kalyan–Dombivli: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/how-to-buy-a-flat-in-kalyan-dombivli/): Set a total budget that includes stamp duty and other costs, shortlist three or four projects, verify RERA and title, sign and register the agreement, then arrange the loan and take possession with an occupancy certificate.
- [Stamp Duty and Registration Charges in Maharashtra Explained](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/stamp-duty-registration-charges-maharashtra/): At the time of writing, stamp duty in Mumbai is 6% for men and 5% for women buying residential property in their sole name, including 1% metro cess. Registration is 1% of the value, capped at ₹30,000 above ₹30 lakh. Rates in other municipal areas can differ, so confirm locally.
- [How to Check RERA Registration Before You Buy in Maharashtra](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/check-rera-registration-before-you-buy/): Look up the project's MahaRERA registration number on the official MahaRERA website, confirm that the promoter, plot, approvals and completion date match what you were told, and never pay a token amount for a project that is not registered.
- [Home Loan Eligibility and EMI: A Practical Guide for Buyers](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/home-loan-eligibility-emi-guide/): Lenders look at your income, existing EMIs, credit score and the property itself. RBI limits how much of the value a lender can finance, so you need to arrange a down payment of roughly 10% to 25% depending on loan size, plus the costs on top of the price.
- [Under-Construction vs Ready-to-Move Flats: What to Choose](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/under-construction-vs-ready-to-move/): Ready-to-move flats cost more upfront but carry less risk and, with an occupancy certificate, no GST. Under-construction homes are cheaper and can be paid in stages, but you wait for possession and carry delivery risk, which RERA reduces but does not remove.
- [Documents to Check Before Buying Property in Maharashtra](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/documents-to-check-before-buying-property/): Check the chain of title, the approved plan and commencement or occupancy certificate, RERA registration for new projects, the 7/12 extract or property card for land, and society or builder NOCs. Have your lawyer review everything before you pay.
- [Buying a Resale Flat in Maharashtra: The Complete Checklist](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/buying-a-resale-flat-checklist/): For a resale flat, confirm clear title, a society NOC, the share certificate, no outstanding dues, the state of the building and any redevelopment plan, and ask the society about transfer charges before you commit.
- [What Is the Ready Reckoner Rate and Why Does It Matter?](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/ready-reckoner-rate-explained/): The Ready Reckoner rate is the government's minimum per-square-foot value for a locality. Stamp duty is charged on the higher of the agreement value and the Ready Reckoner value, so you cannot reduce stamp duty by showing a lower price.
- [Rent or Buy in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region?](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/rent-or-buy-in-mumbai-metropolitan-region/): Buy if you plan to stay at least five to seven years, can manage the EMI comfortably and have the down payment ready. Rent if you are likely to move, or if the rent is much lower than the EMI and you can invest the difference with discipline.
- [Capital Gains Tax When You Sell Property in India](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/capital-gains-tax-on-property-sale/): Property held for more than 24 months is taxed on long-term gains at 12.5% without indexation. For property bought before 23 July 2024, resident individuals and HUFs can choose the lower of 12.5% without indexation or 20% with indexation. Reinvestment exemptions can reduce the tax.
- [Investing in the Kalyan Corridor: Opportunities and Risks](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/property-investment-kalyan-corridor/): Buyers are watching the Kalyan corridor because of its rail links, lower prices than Thane and Mumbai, and metro and road projects. The risks are project delays, oversupply in some pockets and uneven quality, so choose RERA-registered projects with a strong delivery record.
- [NRIs Buying Property in Maharashtra: Rules and Steps](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/nri-buying-property-in-maharashtra/): NRIs and OCI cardholders can buy residential and commercial property in India without special RBI permission, but not agricultural land, plantation property or a farmhouse. Payment must go through proper banking channels, and rules on repatriation and tax apply.

The project page lists 1 BHK homes of 404 to 519 sq. ft. from ₹55 Lakh, 2 BHK homes of 577 to 721 sq. ft. from ₹75 Lakh and 3 BHK homes from ₹1.40 Crore, with retail and office space on request, possession listed as June 2027* and a sample flat ready to visit.

- [5 BHK Flats in Kalyan West: Jodi Homes and What to Check](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/5-bhk-flats-in-kalyan-west/): True 5 BHK flats are rare in Kalyan West. Most are Jodi homes, where two adjoining flats on the same floor are combined into one residence. Prestige One at Godrej Hill, Khadakpada offers a 5 BHK (Jodi) alongside its 3 BHK homes, with layouts and prices shared on request. Before buying any Jodi home, confirm how the two units appear in the approved plan, the MahaRERA filing, your agreement and the society records.
- [3 BHK Flats in Kalyan West: Prestige Gold and Prestige One](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/3-bhk-flats-in-kalyan-west/): Prestige Projects offers 3 BHK flats in Kalyan West at two addresses. Prestige Gold, near Mahavir Jain School at Kala Talao, lists its 3 BHK at ₹1.40 Cr with a pooja room, walk-in wardrobe and three bathrooms, with possession targeted for June 2027. Prestige One at Godrej Hill, Khadakpada offers 3 BHK homes with prices and carpet areas on request. Compare both on RERA carpet area, total cost, floor and possession date before booking.
- [1 BHK & 2 BHK Flats near Kala Talao, Kalyan West: Prestige Gold](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/1-bhk-2-bhk-flats-near-kala-talao-kalyan-west/): Prestige Gold, near Mahavir Jain School at Kala Talao in Kalyan West, lists 1 BHK homes of 404–519 sq ft (RERA carpet) from ₹55 Lakh and 2 BHK homes of 577–721 sq ft from ₹75 Lakh, with possession targeted for June 2027. A sample flat is open every day from 10am to 7pm. Call or WhatsApp 96895 57788 for a cost sheet and visit.
- [Flats in Khadakpada & Godrej Hill, Kalyan West: Area Guide](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/flats-in-khadakpada-kalyan-west/): Khadakpada is a residential part of Kalyan West, and Godrej Hill is one of its best-known pockets. From Prestige One at Godrej Hill, schools such as Podar International and Vibgyor, Aayush and Shwaas hospitals and DMart are each about 1 km away, and Fortis Hospital Kalyan is about 4 km. The approved Metro Line 5A plan includes a Khadakpada station, targeted for around 2030–31. Prestige One offers 3 BHK and 5 BHK (Jodi) homes here.
- [New Projects in Kalyan West: A Buyer's Checklist](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/new-projects-in-kalyan-west/): There are many new and under-construction residential projects in Kalyan West, from Kala Talao and the station area to Khadakpada and Godrej Hill. Before you book any of them, check the MahaRERA registration and completion date, compare RERA carpet area rather than built-up area, read the payment plan and agreement, and visit at peak hours. Prestige Projects offers two addresses: Prestige Gold near Kala Talao (1, 2 and 3 BHK from ₹55 Lakh, possession targeted June 2027) and Prestige One at Godrej Hill (3 BHK and 5 BHK Jodi).
- [Ready Reckoner Rate in Kalyan: How to Check the RR Rate](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/ready-reckoner-rate-in-kalyan/): The ready reckoner (RR) rate is the government's minimum value per square metre for property in each zone. For Kalyan, look it up on the Maharashtra IGR website under eASR: choose the year, Thane district, Kalyan taluka and then your village or municipal zone. Stamp duty is charged on the higher of your agreement value and the RR value, so the RR rate matters even when you pay more than it.
- [How to Check a MahaRERA Registration Number: Step by Step](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/how-to-check-maharera-registration-number/): To check a MahaRERA registration number, open the official MahaRERA website, go to the registered projects search, and enter the number or the project name. Then confirm that the promoter, project name, address, completion date and approved plans match what you were told, and read the quarterly progress updates. Never pay a booking amount for a project you cannot find on the portal.
- [Metro Line 5 & 5A in Kalyan: Stations, Phases and Timelines](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/upcoming-infrastructure-kalyan-metro-line-5/): Metro Line 5 links Thane, Bhiwandi and Kalyan. Phase 1, from Balkum in Thane to Dhamankar Naka in Bhiwandi, is about 11.9 km with six stations and is targeted to open around December 2026. Phase 2 continues about 10.48 km to Durgadi in Kalyan. The 5A extension, approved by the Centre in August 2026, runs about 11.83 km from Durgadi to Ulhasnagar with stations including Khadakpada and Kalyan, and is targeted for around 2030–31.
- [Total Cost of Buying a Flat in Kalyan West: Every Charge](https://www.prestigeenterprises.in/blog/total-cost-of-buying-a-flat-in-kalyan-west/): The total cost of a flat in Kalyan West is more than the agreement value. Depending on how the price is quoted, add GST for under-construction homes (usually 5%, or 1% for affordable homes, nil for ready homes with an occupancy certificate), stamp duty (commonly about 7% in Kalyan-Dombivli; confirm locally), registration (1%, capped at ₹30,000), plus legal, loan, society, maintenance, parking and interior costs. Always ask for a written cost sheet showing what is included.
